cards.title: Build the Shipward desk core (server + board)
cards.note: SCOPE NARROWED at the quick-dev step-01 checkpoint to the desk core: CAP-1,2,3,6,7,8,9 — serve.mjs, board with drag & drop, card dialog, activity strip, 3s live poll. Archive (SW-003), Raw data (SW-004) and the MCP server (SW-005) split out as separate cards. Built via bmad-quick-dev against _bmad-output/specs/spec-shipward/SPEC.md. Recreate the hi-fi prototype at design_handoff_shipward/design-reference/Shipward-Modernist.dc.html as a static no-build web app in shipward/public, served by shipward/serve.mjs (~60 lines, zero deps, port 4747): GET /api/tracker reads .shipward/tracker.json, PUT /api/tracker does an atomic write (tmp + rename). UI polls GET ~3s so Claude Code's direct file edits appear live. Four views: Board (4 columns + drag & drop), Archive, Raw data, Card dialog. Tokens in design_handoff_shipward/design-reference/assets/modernist-scoped.css — strip the #sw-1a scoping prefix. Radius 0 everywhere. .shipward/schema.json is normative. Full spec: design_handoff_shipward/README.md.

cards.title: Distill the design handoff into a SPEC contract
cards.note: Ran bmad-spec on design_handoff_shipward/. Output: _bmad-output/specs/spec-shipward/ — SPEC.md (10 capabilities), companions data-contract.md + interaction-rules.md, adopted companions README.md + CLAUDE.md, sources tracker.seed.json + seed.js. Both self-validate passes PASS. Decision: README adopted rather than transcribed, so the token table and screen specs stay single-sourced. Four open questions left for Alberto — MCP tag has no MCP behind it, card-delete contradicts CLAUDE.md 'never delete', shipped-this-month field precedence, projects[] editability. Skill was invoked by loading SKILL.md directly: the session skill registry is rooted at /Users/alberto/projects, so project-local .claude/skills are not callable via the Skill tool.

cards.title: Archive view — shipped cards table
cards.note: SPEC CAP-4. Split from SW-001 at the quick-dev step-01 multi-goal check. h3 'Shipped & archived' + muted lede, .table sorted by shipped desc: Shipped (Mon D) / ID (mono 12px) / What went out / Type / Effort / Commit (mono). Tab label carries the count. Read-only projection over state the desk core already builds.

cards.title: Raw data view — JSON with copy button
cards.note: SPEC CAP-5. Split from SW-001 at the quick-dev step-01 multi-goal check. h3 'Raw board data', secondary Copy JSON button whose label flips to 'Copied — feed it to a machine' for 2s, then a <pre> (surface bg, 1px divider border, mono 12px/1.55, max-height 560px). Field order fixed in data-contract.md: id, title, type, priority, effort, status, claude, branch, commit, created, pushed, shipped — note pri is emitted as 'priority' and p is dropped.

cards.title: MCP server so Claude Code reaches the tracker over MCP
cards.note: Alberto answered 'I want the MCP' at the quick-dev step-01 checkpoint, overriding the decorative-tag default. Real MCP server exposing the tracker as tools, so Claude Code reads/writes cards over MCP instead of editing tracker.json directly, and the header's MCP CONNECTED tag reflects a real connection. CONSEQUENCES: invalidates the SPEC non-goal 'No MCP server is built' (needs a bmad-spec re-derive) and implies rewriting CLAUDE.md, whose protocol currently instructs direct file edits. Independent of the desk core — a second client onto the same tracker.json. Until this lands, the header tag renders per the prototype but is wired to nothing.
